playerPage.f1.desc.en: Check real-time availability of indoor, panoramic, or outdoor courts. Choose your slot, split the fee, and receive instant confirmation without phone calls.

playerPage.f1.tech.en: Sub-millisecond collision prevention and instant confirmation.
playerPage.f1.tech.es: Prevención de colisiones de reserva por microsegundo y confirmación inmediata.

playerPage.f1.title.es: Reserva Rápida en Menos de 15 Segundos

playerPage.f2.desc.en: Need a fourth player? Create or join open matches filtered by your exact decimal rating (e.g. 3.75) and preferred court side (drive, backhand, or either).

playerPage.f2.tech.es: Algoritmo ELO adaptado a pádel por parejas que recalcula el rating tras cada partido.

playerPage.f3.desc.en: Each player pays their 25% share directly from their smartphone via mobile pay, credit card, or club wallet. Never chase friends for money again.
playerPage.f3.desc.es: Cada jugador paga su 25% de la pista directamente desde su propio móvil por Bizum, tarjeta o monedero virtual. Olvídate para siempre de perseguir a tus amigos para que te paguen.

playerPage.f3.tech.en: Direct settlement to the club's bank with zero commission withheld from players.
playerPage.f3.tech.es: Liquidación directa al banco del club sin retención de fondos ni comisiones a jugadores.

playerPage.f4.desc.en: Upon booking confirmation, your app instantly generates a PIN and QR code to unlock pedestrian gates, court doors, and activate LED lighting on schedule.

playerPage.f4.tech.en: Native industrial relay and cloud lock integration with offline failover.
playerPage.f4.tech.es: Integración nativa con relés industriales y cerraduras electrónicas IP con tolerancia offline.

playerPage.f5.title.en: Player Card, Skill Level & Pro Stats

playerPage.f6.tech.en: Automated single-elimination bracket generation and real-time score publishing.

playerPage.f6.title.es: Inscripción a Torneos, Pozos y Ligas Sociales
